delivery.outcome: Split src/koru/queue/context.py (code2llm GOD: 581 lines, 4 classes, 14 mutations, max CC=19) by responsibility into three modules behind a stable facade: context_exclusions.py (non-negotiable secret/VCS/generated exclusion policy + _is_excluded), context_files.py (request-driven file selection, glob/auto-include collection, safe bounded reads, file tree) and context_slicing.py (focused AST/line-window slicing of oversized files with target symbol/line resolution). context.py keeps only the assembly pipeline (ContextResult, _context_file_sections, _truncate_context_text, build_project_context, DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS) and re-exports every moved private name via redundant aliases so `from koru.queue.context import ...` stays byte-compatible, including the test-facing _is_excluded and _resolve_target_symbol_and_line. Behavior is preserved verbatim (functions move unmodified); tests/test_llm_context.py passes unchanged and tests/test_queue_context_modules.py pins the moved behavior at its new homes plus the facade re-export surface.
nonGoals: Changing context assembly behavior, output format, exclusions or slicing heuristics
Touching src/koru/queue/runner.py or any other consumer of build_project_context
Splitting or refactoring any other queue module flagged by code2llm

architecture.decision: Move functions verbatim (same private names) into three responsibility modules and re-export them from the koru.queue.context facade with redundant aliases (the koru.scan -> koru.scan_todo pattern). An audit found no monkeypatch/patch targets on koru.queue.context in src/, tests/ or packages/ (the patched koru.context.build_context is a different module), so plain import-time re-exports suffice without call-time facade indirection; the two private names tests import (_is_excluded, _resolve_target_symbol_and_line) keep working through the facade.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single 581-line src/koru/queue/context.py.

validation.evidence: context.py drops from 581 lines to the assembly facade only; each responsibility module stays a focused non-god module.
Existing context suite passes unchanged (51 passed; the test_cursor_llm no-default-cap failure is pre-existing on main and untouched by this ticket) and the new focused suite passes.
